args.sql: SELECT t.nct_id, t.overall_status, t.why_stopped, d.why_stopped_category, t.enrollment, d.results_due_date, d.results_posted FROM trials t JOIN trial_derived d USING (nct_id) WHERE t.nct_id = 'NCT01010373'
